neighbours.label: the baseline half of a contrast with the usual or hypothetical case: the modal or copula after a frame like 'in any other year', 'typically', 'what would normally be a …' ('fans might …', 'would normally be a'), before the sentence turns to what actually happened. Plain statements and a bare future 'might' stay quiet
fire: In any other season, the coach might have been fired after such a run.
Typically, a patient might wait three weeks for these results.
What would normally be a quiet Sunday service drew hundreds of reporters.
Under other circumstances, the two men might have become close friends.
In any other city, a storm like this might pass without comment.
What would ordinarily be a routine vote turned into a six-hour fight.
Typically, a new teacher might take a year to feel at ease.
In another era, critics might have dismissed the film as a trifle.
quiet: Last season, the coach was fired after a long losing run.
The patient waited three weeks for the results of the scan.
A quiet Sunday service was held at the chapel by the lake.
The two men became close friends during the long voyage.
He might call the plumber tomorrow if the tap still drips.
The council held a routine vote on parking fees.
The new teacher took a year to feel at ease.
Critics dismissed the film as a trifle when it opened.

notes: Card: ' might' x2, ' would', ' a', ' for', ' more', '.', after frames such as 'Under other circumstances', 'What is normally', 'Normally', 'What might be a mere fender bender for'. Probes: 'Typically, students might' 0.48, 'Under other circumstances, she might' 0.46, 'In any other year, voters might' 0.40, 'What would normally be a' 0.33, 'that would be unthinkable' 0.29, 'Usually, the birds would' 0.25; 'Normally, the repair would' 0.11, 'Under normal circumstances, a win … would' 0.13; plain statements 0.01-0.04, bare 'She might go to the store' 0.04. The + pole fires on the EARLIER state in a before/after reversal ('which a week before was only …', 'had been so delighted'): both poles mark the side of a contrast that is about to be overturned, - the usual/hypothetical one, + the past one. Strengths are modest, so the median may fall near the 0.20 bar.
